C0113.title: Criminal Gang Providing Fake Reviews for Over 4,000 Online Stores Busted
C0113.summary: The public security bureau of Rongjiang County, Qiandongnan Prefecture, Guizhou Province, dismantled a click-farm criminal gang engaged in fake transactions and review manipulation. Since 2019, the gang had provided fake review services for over 4,000 online stores, fabricating transactions and ratings to inflate merchant metrics, with a total involved capital flow of 370 million yuan.
